<translate>
<!--T:3-->
The '''Buu Saga''' is the fifth saga of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas|story mode]]. It opens, together with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Future Saga|Future Saga]], once you complete every quest of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Android Saga|Android Saga]]. It covers flying lessons with Gohan, the World Tournament, Babidi's ship, [[Special:MyLanguage/Majin Buu|Majin Buu]] in all his forms, spars with Gotenks, Ultimate Gohan and Vegetto, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Hyperbolic Time Chamber|Hyperbolic Time Chamber]] and the final battle on the [[Special:MyLanguage/Sacred Kai Planet|Sacred Kai Planet]].
</translate>

<translate>
<!--T:4-->
Completing every quest of the Buu Saga opens both the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]]. You can play them in any order.
</translate>

</translate>

<translate>
== The Z Sword and Ultimate Power == <!--T:139-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:140-->
Quest 24 can only be started with [[Special:MyLanguage/Potential Unlock|Potential Unlock]] at level 10, and asks for the [[Special:MyLanguage/Z Sword|Z-Sword]] and level 1 of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ultimate|Ultimate]] skill. Both come from [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]]'s Ultimate Challenge on the Sacred Kai Planet (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Training Minigames|Training Minigames]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Notes == <!--T:161-->
</translate>
<translate>
<!--T:162-->
* Completing quest 23, ''Gotenks at Full Power'', unlocks the Sacred Kai Planet as a [[Special:MyLanguage/Space Pod|Space Pod]] destination.
* Quest 2, ''Gravity Device Components'', asks for a Dr. Kikono's Station, a Fuel Generator and 8 Energy Cables (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Gravity Device|Gravity Device]]).
* Quest 3, ''Trunks and Vegeta Training'', opens 10 real-time minutes after it becomes available.
* Quest 36, ''Flying Lessons'', needs level 1 of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Fly|Fly]] skill.
* Several quests send you to [[Special:MyLanguage/Masters|masters]]: [[Special:MyLanguage/Gohan|Gohan]] (quest 36), [[Special:MyLanguage/Piccolo|Piccolo]] (quest 4) and [[Special:MyLanguage/Old Kai|Old Kai]] (quest 42).
* Kid Buu uses the Expert AI tier on Hard.
* Several Movies Saga quests (the later Broly fights, Bio-Broly, the Otherworld Tournament and [[Special:MyLanguage/Janemba|Janemba]]) open after quests 22, 30, 34 and 35 of this saga.
</translate>
